author: ojiudezue
title: Exterior camera seams: operator re-ratification, runtime learning killed, file-injection planned
summary: The exterior camera adjacency graph (which sightings can be linked into one tracked walk) was re-validated against the physical property: 27 seams -> 20, with 10 struck as physically impossible. Runtime/observation-based learning of that graph was explicitly killed. A declarative operator-supplied seam file, modelled on the TOU rate-file loader, is planned but not built.
why: The 2026-08-06 probe derived seams from camera co-firing within 180s. Of the 27 that reached const.py, the operator struck 10 (37%) as physically impossible - several with observed counts of 3-4 AFTER the probe's simultaneity filter. Co-firing measures household movement patterns, not physical adjacency, and in a 4-person household those diverge badly. The failure is asymmetric: a wrong seam merges two different people into one track and SUPPRESSES the second alert (silent security failure), while a missing seam only fragments one person into noisier alerts. Learning biases toward adding edges - toward the silent-failure side.
decision: (1) The adjacency graph is operator-declared physical truth, re-ratified by hand. (2) NO runtime or observation-based adjacency learning - the offline probe is retained only as a suggestion report a human ratifies. (3) If a file-injection path is built, it is a declarative LOADER with a validator, never a learner; the const remains the fail-safe fallback.
implications: Striking back_yard<->front_side_ptz invalidated the premise of the 'founding' circling case: that live track alternated between the detached garage and the front of the main house 5x in 133s. The circling thresholds were fitted to what may be an artifact of a wrong seam (CIRCLING-FOUNDING-CASE-ARTIFACT-1).
EXTERIOR_TRACK_EGRESS_ADJACENT_CAMERAS is DERIVED from the graph, so it must move with it - hot_tub and front_door_aerial drop out. A track seen only on hot_tub no longer auto-classifies 'approach'.
Live egress_cameras is FIVE (adds garage_a, garage_b) while const, the derived list, and the new invariant guard all assume THREE.

The seam branch is HELD undeployed: the written ring contradicts the operator's own per-seam notes on the pool_equipment/Reolink ordering, and 'Madrone PT Ultra' may be a real camera absent from perimeter_cameras.
revisit_trigger: A camera is physically moved or added; or a future operator/property needs the graph without a code change (then build the planned loader, not a learner).
